name: muni

scripts.deploy:web: docker compose --profile services up -d --build customer-web seller-center admin-panel nginx
scripts.tls:renew: docker compose --profile certbot run --rm certbot renew && docker compose exec nginx nginx -s reload

comment:express-types: Every backend service runs express 4.x, but @types/multer depends on @types/express@* which resolves to v5. The v5 ParamsDictionary types req.params values as `string | string[]` — wrong for the express 4 runtime, and the source of a large class of TS2345 errors. Declaring the v4 type packages here makes the root the owner of the hoisted copy so every workspace type-checks against express 4.
comment:mobile: mobile/ is intentionally absent from workspaces above. React Native requires a single hoisted copy of react/react-native and its own Metro haste map; sharing a node_modules tree with the backend services breaks both. It installs and runs standalone (cd mobile && npm install && npx expo start) and has its own package-lock.json.
